scripts.check: vp run fmt && vp run lint && vp run test && vp run build
scripts.launch: vp run deploy:forwarder --rpc-url https://mainnet.base.org --sig "run(string,string,string)" "Mews On Base" MEWS https://openlaunch.lol/api/launch/meta/0x6c22d03544609db5128736706d90d66fc7f45388/0x88e1dc3a35da1600096d3406a2817ae79c2b65a50ee1f5866a7777e34687e130 --broadcast && vp run verify:forwarder
scripts.snapshot: if [ -f .gas-snapshot ]; then exec forge snapshot --check --no-match-test testFuzz; else exec vp run gas; fi
scripts.verify:blockscout: forge verify-contract $(jq -r .transactions[0].contractAddress broadcast/DeployForwarder.s.sol/8453/run-latest.json) src/MewsForwarder.sol:MewsForwarder --chain 8453 --rpc-url https://mainnet.base.org --guess-constructor-args --watch --verifier blockscout --verifier-url https://base.blockscout.com/api/
scripts.verify:forwarder: vp run verify:basescan && vp run verify:sourcify && vp run verify:blockscout
